name: Globe Food Equipment Co.
old_description: Learn how the reimagined slicers empower you to prep without limits
about:
Globe Food Equipment Company is based in Moraine, Ohio, and has spent decades building a reputation around commercial slicers and food-preparation equipment. The company's history emphasizes reliable, high-performance slicers as its founding cornerstone, though a specific founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The manufacturer produces a broad line of commercial foodservice equipment including premium slicers (such as the redesigned S-Series), spiral and planetary mixers, scales, meat choppers, vacuum packaging chambers, cheese shredders, griddles, charbroilers, sandwich grills, electric fryers, immersion circulators (model GSV18), and immersion blenders. The product range is supported by a two-year parts-and-labor warranty, though facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Globe serves the commercial foodservice sector—restaurants, institutional kitchens, and catering operations—through a network of dealers and service technicians. The company also operates a “Try Before You Buy” program that connects buyers with affiliated representative chefs and test kitchens for hands-on demonstrations.

Globe positions itself on lasting value and personal service, highlighting continuous design improvements aimed at reducing service costs, a strong dealer-support network, and a commitment to on-time delivery and competitive pricing.
